final: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting. Build a dense, turbulent core of layered ultramarine, electric teal, and bruised violet, cut through by sharp strokes of warm vermilion and pale gold. Let broad, restless brush gestures collide with fine scratches, translucent washes, dry-brush grit, and patches of thick impasto. Compress color and texture into uneven waves of intensity, then abruptly open into large areas of quiet, smoky gray and near-black negative space. Give the composition a feeling of pressure, uncertainty, and sudden clarity through rhythm, contrast, and spatial tension alone. Every mark must remain purely abstract, with no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Fill the entire square canvas edge to edge; no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
